news.t: PS Medico build 65 (24 Nov 2026): honest salt lists and quiet price tags - 600+ salt compositions corrected against official labels (Ascoril LS, Mucaine, Cremaffin Plus, Cheston Cold, the Panderm creams, Polybion and their whole formula families now show ALL their salts - each corrected pack carries the 'salt list verified' mark); and every catalog-based price now shows a small muted 'approx' (Hindi: लगभग) instead of plain bold numbers, so catalog MRPs are never mistaken for live-checked prices. Worker app and search suggestions updated to match.

PS Medico build 64 (24 Nov 2026): the weekly auto-update era - a free GitHub Actions pipeline now refreshes prices every Monday (NPPA revised MRPs, Jan Aushadhi kendra prices, live re-checks of the whole channel, CDSCO watch), and the worker can also refresh itself every 6 hours (cron). Jan Aushadhi kendra prices appear on matching salt pages ('Same salt at a Jan Aushadhi Kendra'); every medicine table now badges the ~100 chemist-staple brands (crocin, dolo, augmentin...) that every chemist stocks or can order in 1-2 days; the FAQ gained the substitute-push answer (margins, not availability), the five honest price sources, and the score-perspective note; Sensodyne and Zevit joined the famous-brand data. Worker v15: 'Update Now' genuinely rotates prices and every run leaves a visible marker.

PS Medico build 63 (24 Nov 2026): the independent audit, fully answered - child mode now lists ONLY syrup/drop/suspension forms (with a weight-based dose helper and adult tablets kept collapsed under a clear warning); the banned-combination tag follows every medicine onto the prescription list, the comparison, the symptom cards and the search results; every medicine page gained a Share button; the two icon buttons no longer overlap on phones; syrups, creams and drops got a per-ml price; the 69 core-vs-catalog price mismatches are gone (one identity per name+pack+maker now); the same-name-different-maker packs are never merged again; a mistyped brand finds the real top brand first (stresils - Strepsils); the interaction matrix grew to 1,000+ salt pairs; pregnancy guidance covers 199 salts; NLEM-2022 essential-medicine flags and trust scores for every company-name spelling joined; the Hindi interface is complete; and the admin key is no longer baked into the app file. Server v13 adds offline mode, icons, favicon, sitemap, honest report deletes, rate limits, security headers and 8 MB-saving 304s.
